articles.title: Alckmin diz que Flávio Bolsonaro fez 19 exigências e não quer abrir sigilo: 'Vida pública é pública, tem que ser transparente' | G1
articles.standfirst: Vice-presidente afirmou, após agenda em São Paulo, que a campanha de Lula concordou com as 19 exigências apresentadas pelo senador e defendeu transparência de quem ocupa cargos públicos.
articles.summary: Vice-presidente afirmou, após agenda em São Paulo, que a campanha de Lula concordou com as 19 exigências apresentadas pelo senador e defendeu transparência de quem ocupa cargos públicos.
articles.body:
Vice-presidente Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) — Foto: TV Globo

O vice-presidente Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) afirmou nesta quarta-feira (21), após cumprir agenda em São Paulo, que o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), candidato à Presidência, fez 19 exigências para abrir seus sigilos e que, na avaliação do vice, não quer torná-los públicos. Alckmin defendeu que presidente e vice-presidente não deveriam ter sigilos fiscal, bancário nem telefônico.

“Eu acho até que quem é eleito presidente e vice-presidente não devia ter sigilo, nem fiscal nem bancário nem telefônico. Vida pública é pública, tem que ser transparente. Quem quer ter vida privada vai cuidar do setor privado. Agora não é possível ter vida pública e não prestar contas para a sociedade”, disse Alckmin na Casa de Portugal, na região da Liberdade.

O vice-presidente também afirmou que a campanha do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) concordou com as 19 exigências apresentadas por Flávio Bolsonaro .

“O candidato Flávio Bolsonaro fez 19 exigências para abrir o sigilo. Ele não quer abrir o sigilo. Está dando desculpa. Agora, a campanha do presidente Lula se pronunciou por meio de Camilo Santana: nós concordamos com os 19 [pontos], pode abrir”, declarou.

Alckmin voltou a criticar o senador do PL e disse que ele não respondeu os pontos levantados durante o debate realizado na Band no último domingo (18).

“Nada do que foi levantado no debate, inclusive desrespeitoso com o presidente, ele não respondeu nada”, afirmou.

Nesta quarta, o coordenador político da campanha de Lula, senador Camilo Santana (PT-CE), disse que a campanha de Lula vai ao Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) às 11h desta quinta-feira (22) protocolar a resposta ao senador Flávio Bolsonaro.

"Se não tem nada a dever, que ele cumpra o que o presidente propôs. O presidente não tem nada a se opor ao que ele colocou como condicionantes. Amanhã às 11h estaremos no TSE para protocolar a resposta do presidente e é o prazo para ele estar la também", disse Santana.

Em um ato de campanha em Belo Horizonte, Lula comentou o caso e disse que Flávio "inventou um monte de mentiras".

"Esta semana eu pedi para o Flávio abrir sigilo. Hoje ele inventou um monte de mentiras e trucou 6. Eu vou meter um 9 na cara dele amanhã. Vou meter um 9. Ele não tem nenhuma carta boa, só tem mentira. As cartas dele são todas falsas. Eu estou com zap, sete de copas, espada e ouro. E ainda tenho um três de reserva. Ele vai saber o que é um campeão de truco que aprendeu a jogar como mineiro", disse Lula.

Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e Lula (PT) durante o horário eleitoral gratuito dessa quarta-feira (21) — Foto: Reprodução

Entre as principais exigências feitas pela campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro estão:

Sigilos de assessores próximos: apresentação de termos de autorização de quebra de sigilo de assessores, como Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, o "Marcola", ex-chefe de gabinete.

Empresas de familiares e sócios: abertura de contas e sigilos de empresas ligadas a familiares do presidente, incluindo sociedades do filho Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, o "Lulinha", negócios recentes no exterior, empresas de outros filhos, além do Instituto Lula e da empresa L.I.L.S. Palestras desde o ano de 2003.

Caso Master: divulgação integral de registros de visitantes no Palácio do Planalto e detalhes da reunião mantida entre Lula e Daniel Vorcaro em dezembro de 2024.

INSS: esclarecimentos sobre as relações do governo com a lobista Roberta Luchsinger, registros de suas entradas em palácios presidenciais e voos na Força Aérea Brasileira (FAB), e a quebra de sigilo do sindicalista Frei Chico, irmão de Lula.

Cartão corporativo: abertura de todos os gastos do cartão corporativo da Presidência da República desde janeiro de 2023, e de agendas institucionais da primeira-dama, Janja, desde o primeiro ano de mandato.

Em um documento protocolado no Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE), o candidato do PT à reeleição afirma que autoriza a liberação de seus sigilos bancário, fiscal e eletrônico relativos aos últimos 8 anos , e também os de seus parentes, desde que o seu adversário na disputa presidencial, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), faça o mesmo.

De acordo com a petição apresentada pela defesa de Lula ao TSE, a liberação e a ampla divulgação dos dados – seja por meio do sistema Divulga CandContas da Corte Eleitoral, ou de outro site de acesso público – vão abranger os seguintes familiares de Lula:

Rosângela Lula da Silva, a Janja, esposa do presidente;

Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, o Lulinha , filho que é alvo de investigações da PF;

Lula condiciona a liberação dos seus sigilos e os de parentes à autorização, por Flávio Bolsonaro, da divulgação dos sigilos dele e dos seguintes familiares:

E também das seguintes empresas ligadas ao candidato do PL:

Flávio Bolsonaro Sociedade Individual de Advocacia;

Bravo Grafeno Tecnologia e Inovação Ltda.;

Alcazar Holdings, empresa de propriedade de Willer Tomaz, que tem uma conta em que Flávio foi cadastrado como "usuário master".

Flávio Bolsonaro é alvo de dois inquéritos em tramitação no Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) . Um deles, sobre lavagem de dinheiro, investiga a relação do candidato do PL com o advogado Willer Tomaz.

O outro inquérito trata do financiamento de "Dark Horse", uma cinebiografia sobre Jair Bolsonaro. Essa investigação apura negociações envolvendo recursos do banqueiro Daniel Vorcaro, do Banco Master, para a produção do filme.

Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula em entrevista com Renata Lo Prete — Foto: Globo/ Manoella Mello

A campanha de Lula afirmou que segue preocupada com a atuação da Meta durante o período eleitoral mesmo após a reunião de terca-feira (20) no TSE com a empresa.

Segundo a coordenação, a ala jurídica da campanha vai entrar ainda nesta quarta-feira (21) com representações na Justiça Eleitoral contra a Meta.

"A Meta é motivo de grande preocupação para gente e para o mundo democrático. Não vamos aceitar esse tipo de interferência, esse tipo de coisa" afirmou Sidônio Palmeira, ministro da Secretaria de Comunicação (Secom).

articles.title: Ventos no CE atingem 68 km/h e estado tem alerta para rajadas fortes | G1
articles.standfirst: A temperatura máxima no estado pode chegar a 39°C e a umidade relativa do ar pode cair para até 20% em localidades do estado.
articles.summary: A temperatura máxima no estado pode chegar a 39°C e a umidade relativa do ar pode cair para até 20% em localidades do estado.
articles.body:
Previsão da Funceme indica ventos médios entre 18 e 40 km/h e rajadas de 50 a 70 km/h. — Foto: Divulgação

O Ceará apresentou rajadas de vento de até 68 km/h nesta quarta-feira (21). Essa foi a maior velocidade registrada ao longo do dia, em São Benedito , na Serra da Ibiapaba. O dado é da Fundação Cearense de Meteorologia e Recursos Hídricos (Funceme).

Outras cidades também apresentaram velocidades expressivas nesta quarta-feira, como Itatira (52,2 km/h), Icapuí (51,1 km/h), São Gonçalo do Amarante (49,3 km/h) e Marco (49,3 km/h).

Veja abaixo as maiores velocidades registradas nesta quarta-feira:

A Funceme previu um cenário de aumento gradual da velocidade dos ventos entre esta quarta-feira (21) e a madrugada e manhã da quinta-feira (22). A previsão indica ventos médios entre 18 e 40 km/h , com rajadas que podem variar de 50 a 70 km/h .

Segundo a Fundação, a tendência é de que os ventos sejam mais intensos em áreas da faixa litorânea e em ambientes de serra.

Quem também previu ventos fortes no Ceará para esta semana foi a Marinha do Brasil, que alertou para rajadas de até 75 km/h na faixa costeira do Nordeste que vai de Touros, no Rio Grande do Norte, a São Luís, no Maranhão. O trecho inclui todo o litoral cearense. O aviso prevê rajadas de ventos entre as direções sudeste e nordeste entre a noite de terça e a manhã de quinta-feira (22).

Ainda de acordo com a Funceme, a intensificação dos ventos ocorre em meio ao predomínio de estabilidade atmosférica na maior parte do Ceará. Essa condição favorece temperaturas elevadas e baixa umidade relativa do ar, principalmente nas regiões Centro-sul e na Jaguaribana.

As temperaturas máximas devem variar, em geral, entre 32°C e 39°C. As mínimas podem ficar entre 17°C e 19°C em áreas do noroeste e centro-sul do estado.

Apesar do predomínio de tempo firme, há possibilidade de chuva isolada entre a madrugada e a manhã desta quinta-feira (22), principalmente em localidades do sul do Ceará e nos litorais de Fortaleza e do Pecém.

A previsão projeta ainda que a umidade relativa do ar deve permanecer baixa em algumas áreas, com valores mínimos entre 20% e 35% nas regiões Jaguaribana e Centro-sul.

articles.title: Instalação no Irã mostra artista vestido de Trump atrás das grades | G1
articles.standfirst: Artista usando máscara semelhante à do presidente americano ficou preso em uma cela no centro de Teerã.
articles.summary: Instalação artística em Teerã mostrou um artista vestido como Donald Trump em uma cela cenográfica. A apresentação ocorreu em meio às tensões entre Irã e Estados Unidos.
articles.body:
Um artista vestido como o presidente dos Estados Unidos , Donald Trump , foi colocado dentro de uma cela cenográfica em uma instalação no centro de Teerã, capital do Irã , nesta quarta-feira (21).

O homem usava uma máscara semelhante ao rosto de Trump, terno preto e gravata vermelha. A apresentação foi montada sobre um outdoor em uma área movimentada e atraiu a atenção de pedestres e motoristas.

A instalação trazia a frase “É um crime não ver esta cena”.

Na última terça-feira (20), o Irã informou ao chefe do Exército do Paquistão que não negociaria com Washington até que suas exigências fossem atendidas, segundo veículos de comunicação iranianos. O Paquistão atua como intermediário nas tentativas de diálogo entre os dois países.

Os dois países vivem um momento de interrupção dos ataques. Trump anunciou, no começo de setembro, que as ofensivas só seriam retomadas após as eleições legislativas de meio de mandato - as midterms.

Apesar do "cessar-fogo" informal por parte dos americanos, não há nenhum acordo de trégua ou paz definitiva entre os dois países. O Irã tem mantido o controle militar sobre o estreito de Ormuz e atacado embarcações que tentem atravessar a via sem a autorização de Teerã.

articles.title: Pescador fisga dourado de mais de 18kg no Lago Bonsucesso, em Jataí | G1
articles.standfirst: Peixe tem cerca de 1 metro de comprimento e foi capturado por João Alves durante uma pescaria no Lago Bonsucesso. Após fotos, animal foi devolvido à água.
articles.summary: Após fisgar um dourado de 18,6 kg e um metro no Lago Bonsucesso, o pescador João Alves registrou o animal de grande porte e o devolveu às águas de Jataí.
articles.body:
O pescador João Alves fisgou um dourado de 18,6 quilos no Lago Bonsucesso, em Jataí , no sudoeste de Goiás. Com aproximadamente 1 metro de comprimento, o peixe chamou a atenção pelo tamanho durante uma pescaria no fim de semana.

A captura aconteceu no dia 17 de outubro, enquanto João pescava às margens do lago. Segundo relato divulgado ao Bom Dia Goiás sobre a pescaria, ele puxou a linha e percebeu que havia fisgado o peixe. A disputa para retirar o animal da água foi intensa, mas o pescador conseguiu capturá-lo.

Depois da pescaria, João posou para fotos com o dourado e em seguida, o peixe foi devolvido ao lago.

O peixe tem cerca de 1 metro e 18,6 quilos. — Foto: Reprodução/Prefeitura de Jataí

Em entrevista ao g1 , o biólogo Edson Abrão explicou que o dourado é um peixe de água doce encontrado em diferentes países da América do Sul, como Brasil, Paraguai, Bolívia e Argentina.

A espécie é considerada um predador de topo de cadeia alimentar, ou seja, ocupa uma posição elevada na alimentação dos ecossistemas aquáticos. Segundo o especialista, o dourado se alimenta principalmente de outros animais, embora existam registros de indivíduos que também consomem algas.

O peixe pode atingir até 30 quilos, conforme o biólogo. Por isso, um exemplar de 18,6 quilos já é considerado um animal de grande porte.

Abrão explicou ainda que os peixes predadores têm uma função importante no equilíbrio ecológico, pois ajudam a controlar populações de outras espécies aquáticas que podem se reproduzir em grandes quantidades.

De acordo com o biólogo, o dourado costuma ser encontrado em ambientes com água corrente e tem características que favorecem a sobrevivência nesse tipo de habitat. É um peixe forte e resistente, que também pode viver em águas turvas, embora tenha preferência por águas mais limpas.

“Esse peixe gosta muito de águas correntes. Onde tem água bem corrente, ele está lá. Ele é um peixe muito forte, muito resistente”, explicou.

Outra característica da espécie é a coloração. As escamas possuem pigmentos que refletem a luz do sol, contribuindo para a aparência dourada do animal. O peixe também apresenta pequenas manchas pretas e tem hábitos predominantemente diurnos.

Segundo Abrão, o reflexo da luz no corpo do dourado pode ajudá-lo a se camuflar em ambientes com correnteza e pedras. Dessa forma, suas presas podem ter dificuldade para identificá-lo, o que facilita a captura durante a alimentação.

“Quando a água tá corrente, perto de pedras, a luz do sol bate no corpo dele e reflete. Então, os outros peixes o veem como se fosse uma pedra, uma luz do sol refletindo na água”, detalhou.

Depois da pescaria, João devolveu o peixe ao lago. — Foto: Reprodução/Prefeitura de Jataí

*Michely Loures é integrante do programa de estágio entre TV Anhanguera e Universidade Federal de Goiás (UFG), sob orientação de Gilmara Roberto.

articles.title: Unicat Natal amplia funcionamento para domingos e feriados | G1
articles.standfirst: Unidade no Tirol atende de segunda a sábado, das 7h30 às 18h30, e aos domingos e feriados, das 7h30 às 12h30. Agendamento prévio continua obrigatório
articles.summary: A Unicat Natal agora atende diariamente, incluindo domingos e feriados, para entrega de medicamentos de alto custo mediante agendamento prévio obrigatório.
articles.body:
Unicat em Natal — Foto: Sérgio Henrique Santos/Inter TV Cabugi

A Unidade Central de Agentes Terapêuticos (Unicat), em Natal, ampliou o horário de funcionamento e passou a atender todos os dias da semana, inclusive aos domingos e feriados. A mudança foi anunciada pela Secretaria de Estado da Saúde Pública (Sesap) nesta quarta-feira (21).

A unidade fica na Rua Dr. Nilo Bezerra Ramalho, no bairro Tirol , e fornece medicamentos de médio e alto custo pelo Componente Especializado da Assistência Farmacêutica (CEAF).

Com a ampliação, o atendimento ocorre de segunda-feira a sábado, das 7h30 às 18h30. Aos domingos e feriados, o funcionamento é das 7h30 às 12h30.

Os pacientes precisam fazer agendamento prévio antes de comparecer à unidade. O procedimento deve ser feito pelo site de agendamento da Secretaria de Saúde .

As demais unidades da Unicat, incluindo a do Alecrim, em Natal, e as localizadas no interior do estado, continuam funcionando nos horários habituais.

articles.title: Tarcísio reforça preparação de Flávio Bolsonaro para debate na sexta | G1
articles.standfirst: Governador viaja a Brasília nesta quinta-feira (22) para ajudar aliado e deve acompanhá-lo nas últimas agendas de campanha, em MG e no RJ.
articles.summary: Governador viaja a Brasília nesta quinta-feira (22) para ajudar aliado e deve acompanhá-lo nas últimas agendas de campanha, em MG e no RJ.
articles.body:
O governador Tarcísio de Freitas vai participar da preparação de Flávio Bolsonaro para o debate da Globo, na sexta (23) — Foto: Roberto Sungi/Ato Press/Estadão Conteúdo

O governador de São Paulo, Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos), vai participar da preparação de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) para o debate da TV Globo desta sexta-feira (23). Ele passará o dia em Brasília nesta quinta (22) para acompanhar o candidato à Presidência.

A ideia é ajudar a preparar o aliado para ter uma postura "menos Marçal" no confronto com o presidente Lula (PT) e passar uma imagem de estadista.

Em agenda nesta terça (20), o empresário Pablo Marçal, que colabora com a campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro, disse avaliar que o senador "está pronto" para o último debate e que Lula vai encontrar "outra pessoa" na Globo.

A postura de Flávio Bolsonaro no debate do último domingo (18), realizado pela TV Bandeirantes , foi criticada por alguns aliados e pela campanha rival. Também houve a avaliação por parte de pessoas próximas de que faltou a ele estudo e repertório para a apresentação de propostas. No dia do debate, Flávio Bolsonaro participou de um ato na avenida Paulista e não focou a preparação.

Agora, Tarcísio acompanhará o aliado no debate da Globo e, depois, viajará com ele para as duas últimas agendas de campanha do presidenciável, em Belo Horizonte e no Rio de Janeiro.

Outros aliados de Flávio Bolsonaro também devem atuar na preparação. O senador eleito por São Paulo Guilherme Derrite (PP) deve ajudar o senador a se preparar para perguntas sobre segurança pública.

articles.title: Quaest no DF: como está a disputa pelo governo no 2º turno | G1
articles.standfirst: Pesquisa divulgada nesta quarta-feira (21) é a segunda encomendada pela Globo à Quaest no segundo turno. Margem de erro é de três pontos percentuais.
articles.summary: Pesquisa divulgada nesta quarta-feira (21) é a segunda encomendada pela Globo à Quaest no segundo turno. Margem de erro é de três pontos percentuais.
articles.body:
Pesquisa Quaest divulgada nesta quarta-feira (21) mostra como está a disputa pelo governo do Distrito Federal no segundo turno. O levantamento foi encomendado pela Globo.

Esta é a segunda rodada da pesquisa desde a definição dos candidatos que avançaram ao segundo turno, no dia 4 .

A votação será no próximo domingo (25). Na data, eleitores em todo o país e no exterior também decidirão o segundo turno da eleição presidencial, entre Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e Lula (PT) .

Celina Leão (PP) e Leandro Grass (PT), candidatos ao governo do DF no segundo turno — Foto: Ingrid Ribeiro/TV Globo; Amanda Sales/TV Globo

Veja abaixo os números da pesquisa estimulada, em que a Quaest mostra aos eleitores entrevistados os nomes dos candidatos:

Quaest, 21 de outubro: intenção de voto para governador no DF, 2º turno — Foto: Arte/g1

Para 88 % dos eleitores ouvidos no levantamento, a escolha do candidato é definitiva. Outros 12% dizem que ainda podem mudar o voto até o segundo turno.

A Quaest ouviu 1.104 pessoas de 16 anos ou mais entre os dias 17 e 20 de outubro . A margem de erro é de 3 pontos percentuais , para mais ou para menos, e o nível de confiança é de 95% . O número de registro da pesquisa é DF-00402/2026 .

A pesquisa divulgada nesta quinta (21) também mediu a avaliação e a aprovação do governo Celina Leão (PP).

➡️ A atual governadora assumiu o cargo em março deste ano – até então, era vice de Ibaneis Rocha (MDB). Ibaneis deixou o governo do DF para disputar o Senado, mas desistiu em seguida .

Segundo a pesquisa Quaest, 34% dos eleitores consideram a gestão Celina Leão "ótima ou boa" e 25% consideram "ruim ou péssima".

Ótima ou boa: 34% (eram 39% no levantamento anterior, em 12 de outubro );

articles.title: Alagoas cria regras para recarga de carros elétricos em condomínios | G1
articles.standfirst: Norma do Corpo de Bombeiros proíbe uso de tomadas comuns nas garagens. Prédios terão prazos para adaptar instalações e reforçar sistemas de segurança.
articles.summary: Nova norma do Corpo de Bombeiros exige instalações profissionais e sistemas de segurança para recarga de carros elétricos em condomínios e garagens de Alagoas.
articles.body:
O Corpo de Bombeiros Militar de Alagoas (CBMAL) estabeleceu novas regras para a instalação e o uso de carregadores de carros elétricos em condomínios, garagens e estacionamentos do estado.

As normas foram publicadas no Diário Oficial desta quarta-feira (21). Elas determinam medidas para evitar incêndios e acidentes elétricos , além de estabelecer prazos para adequação de prédios que já possuem equipamentos de recarga.

Entre as principais mudanças estão a proibição de carregar veículos em tomadas comuns, a obrigatoriedade de instalação por profissionais habilitados e a exigência de sistemas de prevenção contra incêndios em determinadas edificações.

As regras fazem parte da Instrução Técnica nº 45/2026. Elas se aplicam a edifícios residenciais e comerciais que possuem pontos de recarga.

Para casas unifamiliares, as orientações têm caráter de recomendação.

A norma entrou em vigor nesta quarta-feira (21), mas estabelece prazos diferentes para a adaptação de instalações existentes. Em alguns casos, os condomínios terão até cinco anos para implementar determinados sistemas de segurança.

O que muda para quem tem carro elétrico?

Carregamento de carro elétrico em garagem ou estacionamento — Foto: smart-me AG/Pexels

Uma das principais mudanças é que os moradores não poderão utilizar tomadas comuns das garagens para carregar os veículos. Também não poderão recorrer a extensões, adaptadores ou réguas de tomadas.

Nas garagens internas dos condomínios, serão permitidos apenas os modos de recarga 3 e 4, que utilizam equipamentos específicos para o abastecimento elétrico dos automóveis.

Nos prédios que já tinham projetos de segurança aprovados antes das novas regras, há uma restrição adicional: os carregadores rápidos, classificados como modo 4, só poderão ser utilizados se o edifício cumprir todas as exigências de segurança previstas para esse tipo de instalação.

Já em áreas externas, poderão ser utilizados os quatro modos de recarga previstos nas normas técnicas, desde que sejam cumpridas as exigências de segurança.

O Corpo de Bombeiros recomenda que os carregadores sejam instalados preferencialmente em áreas externas .

Como será feita a instalação dos carregadores?

A infraestrutura elétrica que leva energia até o carregador faz parte do prédio e pode ser compartilhada entre os demais condôminos. — Foto: Reprodução/TV Globo

Os condomínios deverão contratar profissionais habilitados para instalar os equipamentos.

Antes da instalação, será necessário avaliar se a rede elétrica do prédio suporta o aumento do consumo de energia.

Essa avaliação deverá identificar, por exemplo, se será preciso trocar a fiação, os transformadores ou os quadros de distribuição de energia.

O profissional responsável também deverá emitir um documento de responsabilidade técnica , registrado no respectivo conselho profissional, e um relatório com informações sobre a instalação, incluindo a quantidade de carregadores, a capacidade elétrica e os dispositivos de proteção utilizados.

Os equipamentos deverão contar com sistemas de aterramento, proteções elétricas próprias e dispositivos de desligamento manual para situações de emergência.

A norma também determina que os pontos de recarga tenham identificação e sinalização de segurança, além de orientações sobre como desligar os equipamentos e acionar o Corpo de Bombeiros.

Condomínios terão que instalar sistemas contra incêndio?

Um carro elétrico é carregado em estação de recarga; estudo analisou o impacto climático da troca de veículos a combustão por modelos elétricos. — Foto: Pexels

A exigência depende das características do edifício e da situação do projeto de segurança contra incêndio.

Para novas instalações em prédios com área superior a 750 m² ou altura superior a 12 metros, a norma prevê medidas adicionais, como sistemas de detecção e alarme de incêndio, chuveiros automáticos, conhecidos como sprinklers, exaustão mecânica de fumaça e requisitos de resistência ao fogo da estrutura.

Nos prédios que já tinham projetos aprovados antes da publicação das novas regras, há condições específicas de adaptação.

Entre as exigências estão sistemas de detecção e alarme de incêndio, chuveiros automáticos e gerenciamento de riscos.

O objetivo é permitir que um possível incêndio seja identificado rapidamente e que os equipamentos de segurança ajudem a reduzir os riscos para moradores e trabalhadores.

As novas regras estabelecem prazos diferentes conforme a situação dos prédios:

180 dias: edificações que já possuem carregadores instalados deverão adequar os equipamentos às exigências básicas da norma.

360 dias: prédios com mais de 750 m² ou altura superior a 12 metros, que se enquadrem nas regras para projetos anteriormente aprovados, deverão apresentar ao Corpo de Bombeiros a substituição do projeto de segurança contra incêndio.

Até cinco anos: prazo de regularização das exigências específicas para edificações com projetos já aprovados.

A norma também estabelece que os sistemas de chuveiros automáticos, detecção e alarme de incêndio dessas garagens deverão estar instalados até 1º de novembro de 2031.

As exigências básicas de segurança devem ser observadas na instalação de novos carregadores, sem depender do prazo de cinco anos.

Onde os carregadores poderão ser instalados

Os equipamentos não poderão ser instalados em corredores ou rotas de fuga do prédio.

Nos edifícios que possuem apenas uma saída de emergência, será necessário manter uma distância mínima de cinco metros entre a área de estacionamento destinada à recarga e essa saída.

Os carregadores instalados em formato de totem também deverão ter proteção física contra possíveis colisões de veículos, como muretas, pilares ou outras estruturas de segurança.

Além disso, os dispositivos de desligamento manual deverão ficar a, no máximo, cinco metros dos equipamentos de recarga.

Também deverá haver mecanismos para interromper o fornecimento de energia aos carregadores de cada pavimento e de toda a edificação.

articles.standfirst: Programação reúne estudantes do Pinocchio e do Colégio Martha Falcão em projetos sobre ciência, tecnologia, cultura e futuro
articles.summary: Programação reúne estudantes do Pinocchio e do Colégio Martha Falcão em projetos sobre ciência, tecnologia, cultura e futuro
articles.body:
Estudantes apresentam projetos durante a Feira Científico-Cultural das Instituições Nelly Falcão de Souza. — Foto: Divulgação/INFS

A ciência, a tecnologia, a cultura e a criatividade dos estudantes estiveram reunidas em mais uma edição da Feira Científico-Cultural INFS , que em 2026 completou 40 anos de história. Com o tema “Quatro Décadas que Transformaram o Mundo — e o Futuro que Começa Agora” , a programação foi realizada nas unidades do Pinocchio Centro Educacional e do Colégio Martha Falcão , em Manaus, e propôs uma viagem pelas principais transformações científicas, tecnológicas, culturais e socioambientais ocorridas desde 1986, além de convidar os alunos a imaginar os próximos dez anos. A visitação foi aberta ao público externo, incluindo alunos e pais de outras escolas.

Entre os destaques da feira esteve a participação dos pais e responsáveis, assim como pesquisadores de órgãos importantes do Amazonas, entre eles, Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas da Amazônia (INPA/MCTI), Universidade Federal do Amazonas (UFAM), Universidade do Estado do Amazonas (UEA), Centro de Bionegócios da Amazônia (CBA), Instituto Federal do Amazonas (IFAM), Secretaria de Estado do Meio Ambiente (Sema) e Empresa Brasileira de Pesquisa Agropecuária (Embrapa).

No Pinocchio, a feira foi realizada no dia 19 de setembro, com a participação de 91 alunos de oito turmas, responsáveis pela apresentação de nove projetos. Já no Colégio Martha Falcão, a programação ocorreu nos dias 23 e 25 de setembro, contemplando, respectivamente, os Anos Iniciais e os Anos Finais e Ensino Médio.

A proposta deste ano foi estruturada em cinco eixos temáticos, que percorreram diferentes momentos entre 1986 e 2036. Os quatro primeiros revisitaram as décadas de existência da feira, enquanto o quinto projetou o futuro. O percurso passou pelas origens, pela chegada da internet, pela aceleração provocada pelos smartphones e redes sociais e pelo atual cenário marcado pela inteligência artificial, pandemia, emergência climática e protagonismo da Amazônia no debate global. O último eixo convidou os estudantes a pensarem nas transformações que poderão marcar a próxima década.

Mais do que uma exposição de trabalhos, a Feira Científico-Cultural foi desenvolvida como parte da rotina pedagógica dos estudantes. As pesquisas foram construídas ao longo de várias semanas, envolvendo conversas, observações, experiências, pesquisas, atividades práticas e produções realizadas pelos próprios alunos.

A interdisciplinaridade foi um dos principais elementos da proposta. Ciências, História, Matemática, Linguagem, Arte, Tecnologia e Educação ambiental apareceram integradas nos projetos, permitindo que os estudantes relacionassem diferentes conhecimentos para compreender situações do cotidiano e propor novas possibilidades.

No Pinocchio, por exemplo, entre os projetos desenvolvidos estiveram “Meios de Comunicação”, que compara as formas de comunicação do passado e do presente; “Como chegamos até aqui”, sobre a evolução dos meios de transporte e a busca por alternativas mais sustentáveis; e “Brincar ontem e hoje”, que resgata brinquedos e brincadeiras de outras gerações.

Também foram apresentados trabalhos como “Papelão e criatividade - Pequenos arquitetos”, que transforma materiais que seriam descartados em brinquedos e construções, e “A tecnologia da natureza”, que observa soluções encontradas em seres vivos, como a arquitetura do joão-de-barro, a resistência das teias de aranha e a organização das abelhas.

Além das pesquisas, o público pôde conhecer maquetes, protótipos, exposições e produções construídas pelos próprios estudantes. A intenção foi apresentar não apenas o resultado final, mas também o caminho percorrido durante a elaboração dos trabalhos, incluindo perguntas, hipóteses, descobertas e experimentações.

Para o diretor de Marketing do grupo, Nelson Falcão, "A Feira representa uma das iniciativas que melhor traduzem a proposta de formação integral defendida pelas instituições" , destaca.

A perspectiva de formação integral também apareceu na própria concepção da edição comemorativa. O projeto dos 40 anos propôs uma reflexão sobre a diferença entre a velocidade do desenvolvimento científico e tecnológico e o ritmo do desenvolvimento humano, colocando questões como ética, relações interpessoais, atenção, convivência e responsabilidade no centro da discussão.

Nesse sentido, os estudantes foram colocados não apenas como espectadores das transformações, mas como protagonistas na construção de possibilidades para o futuro. O quinto eixo, que aborda o período de 2026 a 2036, propôs justamente que eles utilizassem fundamentação científica e criatividade para imaginar os próximos avanços, sem deixar de discutir como garantir que o desenvolvimento humano acompanhe o progresso tecnológico.

articles.title: In 1937, Tolkien’s first edition of The Hobbit was published; a Dundee charity shop manager later found a copy that sold for £10,099.50
articles.summary: A first edition of J.R.R. Tolkien's The Hobbit was discovered by a charity shop manager in Dundee and sold for a staggering £10,099.50 on eBay, benefiting cancer research.
articles.body: A first edition copy of J.R.R. Tolkien’s The Hobbit was sold on eBay for more than £10,000 in 2023, after a store manager discovered it, according to the Guardian. Although the charity normally priced items at £5 or less, the book’s age and rarity led staff to send it to the organisation’s online sales team. The book was part of the first print run of 1,500 copies published in 1937, and these early editions featured black-and-white illustrations by Tolkien, alongside the fantasy story of Bilbo Baggins and his adventures; they quickly sold out after their publication and received positive reviews. Contrary to the store manager’s initial estimate of £500, the rare find ultimately secured a massive financial return for the charity, which went towards funding cancer research across the UK.How a rare book was discovered in the backroomAdam Carsley, the manager of the Dundee superstore, found the copy while training new managers and organising stock of hundreds of books stored in the backroom. Once he had examined the book, which was in good condition, he identified it as a first edition, but there was a caveat: the book’s value made it unsuitable for a shop-floor sale. Instead of just stocking the book among the store’s existing catalogue, he considered whether a better return could be yielded through the charity’s online operation. “I opened the first page to see it was a first edition and thought it may be worthy of sending to the eBay team,” Carsley said.The decision proved to be the correct one because the online sale exceeded the price Carsley had estimated. The transaction also set a record for a single item sold through the charity shop’s eBay account, according to Carsley, who described it as one of the most valuable donations the organisation had received at its stores.The market for early editions of The HobbitThe Dundee sale formed part of a wider market for rare copies of children’s literature. A first edition of The Hobbit, which contained an inscription in Old English by Tolkien, sold for £137,000 in 2015. Selling for more than twice the previous amount, that transaction easily dethroned the existing £50,000 world record for a copy of the book.It would be remiss not to mention the distinction between the two books, which dictated its value. The 2015 copy included Tolkien’s inscription, whereas what made the Dundee volume valuable was that it belonged to the original 1937 print run. Consequently, the higher figure reflects the value of an inscribed copy rather than a definitive valuation of the copy held by the charity shop.Another comparable sale took place in 2023, when a first edition of Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone sold for £10,500 to a buyer in Los Angeles. Published by Bloomsbury in 1997, the book was one of 500 copies and had been bought for 30p by a collector from Staffordshire after a library withdrew it from use. Notably, the Hobbit copy came from a larger run of 1,500 copies yet fetched a nearly identical sum.These transactions illustrate how early editions can command high prices when collectors seek books with limited print runs or distinctive features, though the sale figures do not establish a uniform value for every first edition because individual copies have different histories and characteristics.You use AI every day. articles.title: In 1513, Albrecht Dürer made Knight, Death and the Devil; centuries later, an English boy rescued a print from a dump, and it sold for £22,680 at auction
articles.summary: A remarkable 500-year-old engraving by Albrecht Dürer, titled The Knight, Death and the Devil, was found in a rubbish tip and sold for £33,390 at auction, exceeding initial estimates by over £13,000. Discover the story behind this incredible find and its historical significance.
articles.body: A 500-year-old engraving by German Renaissance artist Albrecht Dürer was rescued from being thrown away at a rubbish tip in Kent and was sold for £22,680 in September 2024, according to the BBC. The artwork, titled The Knight, Death and the Devil, was put up for auction with an initial estimate ranging from £10,000 to £20,000. Mat Winter, who was an avid visitor to the local tip for antiques since he was 10, found the artwork among the belongings a woman was preparing to throw away. After it caught his attention, he asked the woman if he could keep it, and she agreed. Along with his other finds, Winter had stored the artwork for about 13 years until he sought an appraisal in 2024, at 24.The discovery came as a surprise to auction house director Jim Spencer, since Dürer’s prints have been copied over the centuries, which caused him to suspect the item might be a later reproduction. However, after examining it, he concluded that the paper and the precision of the engraving pointed to an early impression made from Dürer’s original copper plate.A faint mark helped establish its authenticitySpencer, along with his brother and colleague Matty, took the artwork to the British Museum, where it was compared with other variations stored in the museum’s collection. They were helped by a research fellow to examine engravings closely, and used a magnifying glass to contrast individual lines and details.The examination found one feature that stood out: a barely visible cross on the head of the knight’s horse, accidentally made on the copper plate before the print was produced. Because the mark remained absent from later printing after the plate was corrected, its very presence supported the conclusion that the print belonged to an early impression rather than a later copy.Another key detail, Jim Spencer said, was the laid texture of the paper, which was consistent with the period, while the engraving’s fine detail and contrast were unusually well preserved. The artwork had been pasted onto a mount, which directly affected its value; had it been without mounting, it would’ve commanded a price close to £200,000 as reported by Rare Book Auctions. However, it should be noted that this was a comparison with a better-preserved example, not the expected or achieved price for Winter’s print.One of three celebrated master engravingsThe artwork Knight, Death and the Devil was completed in 1513 and is considered one of the three works commonly grouped as Dürer’s Meisterstiche or master engravings. The other two works are called Saint Jerome in His Study and Melencolia I, both of which were made in 1514. The three prints personify the different themes of moral virtue, active life, theological contemplation, and intellectual life.One interpretation claims it represents the Christian knight persevering despite the presence of death and evil. Dürer, who lived from 1471 to 1528, worked as a painter and printmaker and spearheaded the Northern Renaissance as a leading figure. Renowned for the technical quality of woodcuts and copper-plate engravings, his work was instrumental in bridging the gap between the Italian Renaissance and Northern European art. Winter’s print was sold through Rare Book Auctions’ inaugural sale, which ran online and ended on 18 September 2024. The buyer was reported to be a private collector in Germany, meaning the engraving went back to the country where Dürer was born.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: James Talarico blames rise in GOP 'extremism' for prompting his 'God is non-binary,' six sexes remarks
articles.summary: James Talarico says Republican extremism forced him to address trans issues and gender debates he never intended to discuss in the Texas Legislature.
articles.body: Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico blamed Republican extremism for prompting some of his past controversial remarks during a new interview, including assertions that God is "nonbinary" and that there are six biological sexes, arguing that those weren't issues he ran for office to discuss. Talarico said that culture war issues became more prominent in the 2021 Texas state legislature and suggested Republicans were responsible for the increased attention to those topics. Talarico, in 2021, opposed a bill to ban men from women’s sports and claimed that "God is non-binary" while on the Austin, Texas, House floor. Additionally, at a Texas House Committee on Public Education hearing in 2021, he stated, "Modern science obviously recognizes that there are many more than two biological sexes; in fact, there are six." Talarico, who is running against Republican Ken Paxton in the state's closely watched U.S. Senate race, spoke to The New York Times' Michael Barbaro on the paper's "The Daily" podcast Tuesday. He said he felt compelled to fight what he described as Republican extremism at the time when asked about the comments. JAMES TALARICO ADMITS PAST COMMENTS 'MISSED THE MARK' WHEN CONFRONTED ON CLAIMS LIKE GOD IS 'NON-BINARY' "I was put in a position where I had to fight back against that extremism. So, you mentioned some of my comments on gender or on issues affecting trans people. It's not like I ran for the legislature to talk about these things. Again, if you go back to my first session, I wanted to talk about public education, which is why I ran in the first place," he said, pointing to other issues on which he ran. "It's kind of ironic that they're clipping these things to make it sound like I'm the one who was talking about this when, in reality, it was the Republican extremists at the Capitol who were obsessed with talking about trans issues, obsessed with talking about people's private parts. That wasn't me. That was them that changed." DEM SCRAMBLES TO CHANGE TUNE ON TRANS ATHLETES AS TRUMP TARGETS PAST RECORD: ‘ANNIE TRANNIE’ Talarico was asked whether some Democratic positions on cultural issues around 2020 had gone too far. The Democratic Senate candidate said that, at the national level, the party may have gone too far. But at the state level, specifically in Texas, he believed certain bills were targeting and harming his constituents. He pointed to Texas' abortion ban and legislation affecting the LGBTQ community. "These bills targeting LGBTQ people have real ramifications in our state, especially when they're written to be overly broad," he said. "I'm all for if we want to figure out when it's appropriate for a trans athlete to play in a sport. That's a policy discussion that we should have and an issue we should solve. "But the bill that they were trying to pass, the bill they ultimately did pass, was a blanket ban in all cases," he continued. "It treated tee-ball the same as varsity baseball. "And it's because their goal was to score political points off of the backs of a very small, vulnerable group of people in our state. And, so, you know, my values haven't changed, but I was put in a position because of the rise in Republican extremism to defend my constituents." Barbaro asked Talarico if he subscribed to Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, D-N.Y., and her assertion that so-called "Woke One" was "crazy" at a personal level. Talarico said he regretted not articulating his position in a "more straightforward way" but had no regrets about defending his constituents. JAMES TALARICO TORCHES BIDEN BORDER POLICIES IN STUNNING ATTACK AD AS PROGRESSIVE TRIES TO FLIP TEXAS BLUE "So, there's a lot that is said and, when you pull out maybe the most inarticulate of those things to make an attack ad, you know, I certainly regret not articulating my position more clearly, in a more straightforward way to say what I actually mean. And that's going to be true, you know, probably for my entire time in public service. I'm not a perfect person. None of us are. And, so, I'm going to always keep trying to improve how I talk about things so that I'm getting my point across," he said. "I wasn't making a large point about American politics or the Democratic Party. I'll leave those to the pundits and the commentators. All I was trying to say is that I've said things imperfectly, and I'm going to keep working on trying to communicate more clearly and effectively." Inez Stepman, senior policy and legal analyst at Independent Women, criticized Talarico's remarks. "The left is always pulling a bait and switch with cultural issues. They advanced policies that placed males on girls sports teams, in locker rooms, in women’s prisons, and tried to push anyone who objected to that insanity out of public life. Now, they say none of this ever existed or isn’t important. But they don’t change their policy or votes," Stepman told Fox News Digital in a statement. "Not a single Democrat on the federal level voted for a bill to keep men out of women’s sports. If they don’t want to talk about these issues, they could easily put them behind us by ceasing their campaign, including passing laws and regulations that force us to accept men in women’s spaces. But they won’t do that. They merely want us to stop talking about the consequences of their ideas and policies on women and girls." Talarico was recently confronted about some of his comments regarding cultural issues while participating in a "Jubilee"-style town hall, during which voters confronted him one-on-one. Talarico met with a fellow Christian from Texas who pressed him on his past statements. "You've said some concerning things in the past kind of related to faith and social issues. Things such as God is nonbinary, questions about how many genders there really are and your justifications using the Bible for abortion," Sarah Gardner, a small business owner, said to Talarico. EXPERT TEARS APART TALARICO'S VIRAL CLAIM HIS AGENDA IS BASED ON JESUS'S TEACHINGS: 'BUTCHERING THE BIBLE' While explaining some of his comments, he drew a parallel to his own interpretation of Scripture to Charlie Kirk. CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE OF MEDIA AND CULTURE "The first comment about God not being defined by gender, when I said that I was being provocative. And I want to admit that and come clean about that. But I think what I was saying is actually not controversial theologically. "The idea that we can't define God using human categories, not only did I say that, but the late Charlie Kirk said that, the late Pope Benedict said that. And so, yes, I was doing it, maybe in an annoying way, I can admit that," he said. articles.title: Built in 1886, this Manhattan townhouse was bought for $8.8 million in 2012 and transformed in a multimillion-dollar renovation that added a 41-foot indoor pool; now, after a $1 million price cut, it is listed for $10.45 million
articles.summary: A 140-year-old townhouse at 238 West 74th Street on Manhattan’s Upper West Side is on the market for $10.45 million.
articles.body: A 140-year-old townhouse at 238 West 74th Street on Manhattan’s Upper West Side is on the market for $10.45 million. The asking price follows a $1 million price cut, according to a report by Realtor.com. The house spans approximately 6,460 square feet across five levels. It has six bedrooms and six-and-a-half bathrooms, according to the listing on Compass.The 41-foot indoor poolWalk down West 74th Street and 238 looks like its neighbours. There’s brick, brownstone trim and a tall bay window. Nothing from the street hints that the house has a massive pool. That’s right. On the lowest level sits a 41-foot heated pool beneath a skylight. The pool is the centrepiece. Carl Gambino, the listing agent with Compass, says the pool is the feature most likely to catch a buyer’s eye. “A 41-foot heated indoor pool is an exceptionally rare find in an Upper West Side townhouse. It's a private retreat for swimming and unwinding year-round,” he told the outlet. The pool is accompanied by a spa, a steam shower, a wet bar and a dressing room. The floors are heated, so bare feet stay warm on cold mornings. A dehumidification system keeps the air from becoming too humid.Inside the five-storey townhouseThe townhouse was originally built in 1885–86 by William J. Merritt. articles.title: UK Conservative Party suspends ex-candidate after Al Jazeera investigation
articles.summary: The UK’s Conservatives suspend former candidate Jack Ross after he was filmed discussing hiring contract killers.
articles.body:
The UK’s Conservative Party has suspended Jack Ross, a former election candidate and party member, after an Al Jazeera documentary showed him discussing the cost of hiring contract killers and offering to broker the services of a far-right activist with alleged paramilitary links.

Al Jazeera’s undercover investigation , Contract Killers and the Far Right, began in 2021 when an undercover reporter joined Turning Point UK (TPUK), an independent offshoot of the right-wing US activist group Turning Point USA.

TPUK has close ties to several senior British Conservative Party members, as well as to leaders of Reform UK.

TPUK’s CEO Jack Ross stood as a Conservative Party candidate in 2023. Ross introduced Al Jazeera’s undercover reporter to Nesbitt, who is from Glasgow, Scotland.

“Mr Ross’s membership of the Conservative party has been suspended with immediate effect pending an investigation. We cannot comment further while the investigation is ongoing,” a Conservative Party spokesperson told The Guardian.

Ross also told Al Jazeera’s undercover operative that for “a certain amount”, Nesbitt and his contacts could arrange physical attacks.

“They can kick the f*** out of someone. They can start cutting people’s faces up. That’s another amount. They can stab someone,” Ross said. “They can shoot someone. They could kill someone.”

articles.title: Cuba accuses US of threatening countries ahead of UN embargo vote
articles.summary: Havana says Washington is threatening countries with retaliation if they refuse to vote against condemning its embargo.
articles.body:
Cuba has accused the United States of threatening countries with tariffs, visa restrictions and other retaliatory measures in an effort to get them to change their votes on an upcoming United Nations resolution calling for an end to the long-running embargo against the island.

Every year, a majority in the UN General Assembly votes in favour of a nonbinding resolution seeking a stop to the US embargo, which began in the early 1960s.

The embargo, considered the longest in modern history, has been credited with exacerbating economic hardship on the island.

But on Wednesday, Cuban Foreign Minister Bruno Rodriguez said that the administration of US President Donald Trump was seeking to pressure members of the UN General Assembly to vote against the resolution this year.

He explained that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Washington’s ambassador to the UN Mike Waltz were personally leading the campaign, which he alleged had been going on for months.

“It is a new and dangerous way of conducting multilateral diplomacy,” Rodriguez wrote in a statement on the social media platform X. “It reflects the impotence of those who know they are in the wrong and whose only remaining recourse is force.”

Rodriguez said US officials had threatened to suspend cooperation programmes, deny visas to government officials and their families, and even back opposition parties in upcoming elections if countries refused to change their positions.

He also accused the US of urging some countries to abstain or skip the vote altogether if they were unwilling to vote against Cuba.

Al Jazeera has reached out to the US State Department and the US Mission to the UN for comment, but it did not receive a reply by the time of publication.

The allegations come amid escalating tensions between the two countries ahead of the vote on the resolution, expected to take place on October 27 or 28.

The Trump administration has long maintained that the Cuban government — not the embargo — is to blame for the country’s struggling economy, and it has called for regime change.

On Monday, Waltz accused Cuban diplomats of harassing and intimidating participants at a US-hosted panel on alleged human rights abuses in Cuba.

Cuba’s UN Ambassador Ernesto Soberon Guzman and other representatives had confronted Waltz as he left the event at UN headquarters in New York City.

Speaking to reporters afterward, Waltz said that, every year, the Cuban government “propagates a lie through its annual resolution”.

“It uses excuse after excuse to justify its oppression, to justify the misery of the Cuban people, and what we are doing here at the US Mission to the UN is exposing those lies,” he said.

In a separate briefing that day, Waltz also acknowledged that Washington had been lobbying European countries to reconsider their support for the resolution. He pointed to allegations from Ukraine that Cuban nationals fighting for Russia weren’t being paid and that the money was instead going to the Cuban government.

“Yes, we’ve asked many of our European colleagues: Given this evidence from the Ukrainian government, how can they continue to vote for this resolution that is a propaganda tool for the Cuban regime and that is directly affecting their national security?” Waltz said.

The UN General Assembly has voted overwhelmingly in support of resolutions calling for an end to the US economic embargo on Cuba almost every year since 1992. The embargo itself has been in place for more than six decades.

Since the start of 2026, the Trump administration has intensified pressure on Cuba by blocking oil supplies and threatening tariffs on countries supplying the country with fuel, leaving Cubans to face more severe shortages of essential supplies and prolonged blackouts.

articles.title: Rosenberg: US diplomatic push offers little hope for imminent Ukraine peace
articles.summary: President Vladimir Putin does not feel under pressure right now to end the war, the BBC's Russia Editor writes.
articles.body:
After two days of diplomacy – in Norway's capital and Russia's St Petersburg – is the war in Ukraine any closer to ending?

"Good and constructive" is how Norway's prime minister described Tuesday's talks between Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, US President Trump's special envoy Steve Witkoff and European representatives.

In Oslo, the idea of a trilateral meeting at leaders' level was floated. The hope was that Steve Witkoff's trip to Russia would pave the way for President Vladimir Putin, Zelensky and Trump to meet and agree an end to the fighting.

But Putin has shown little desire to share a table with Zelensky - unless that table is in Moscow.

The Kremlin says it may be willing to resume trilateral talks next month in Abu Dhabi, but only at the technical level.

In a post on X, Steve Witkoff himself conceded that "there is still important work to do", though he claimed "President Trump remains committed to seeing this war end..."

Russia says it is ready to resume talks with Ukraine and US to end war

Trump and Zelensky at loggerheads despite new optimism

US citizen Stephen Hubbard freed by Russia as Trump envoy meets Putin

For me, the most telling statement of the day was from Vladimir Putin's foreign policy aide Yuri Ushakov. He took part in the St Petersburg talks.

Ushakov said that Steve Witkoff had told President Putin about the discussions in Oslo and (as Witkoff viewed them) "new approaches from the Europeans and Kyiv".

The Kremlin adviser was clearly unimpressed by what he heard.

"In terms of resolving the Ukraine crisis, there wasn't much there that was useful," commented Ushakov.

Later Russian state TV asked him about the prospects for peace.

"I don't know how close we are getting," Yuri Ushakov said, "but things are moving in that direction."

It seems that President Putin doesn't feel under pressure right now to end the war.

He knows that Ukraine's air defences are under severe strain.

He knows that winter is coming and may well view the cold weather as an opportunity to pound Ukraine into submission.

He knows, too, that there is a US president in the White House who clearly wants a bigger, better, more profitable relationship with Moscow.

In recent days Donald Trump has paused some sanctions on Moscow, has agreed to buy Russian diesel and expressed biting criticism of President Zelensky.

That suits Russia just fine. It eases the pressure on the Kremlin leader.

"Right now Trump is the only leader in the Western world who is doing something for peace," Russian MP and TV anchor Evgeny Popov says.

"Doing something for peace, but a peace on your terms?" I respond. "Is that what you want?"

A Putin-Zelensky-Trump trilateral may not be imminent.

But in China next month a meeting between Vladimir Putin, Donald Trump and Xi Jinping may well take place on the fringes of the Apec summit.

Some commentators here are already dubbing it "The New Yalta" - a reference to the Yalta Conference of 1945, where Stalin, Churchill and Roosevelt met to plan the political and territorial reorganisation of post-war Europe.

"Russia, China and the United States are the only superpowers right now in the world," Evgeny Popov says. "Of course, it will be good for the entire world if our leaders meet in China."

After nearly five years of war, that would put Vladimir Putin exactly where he wants to be - at the top table of global politics.

articles.title: Officer who found man dead in Florida home allegedly moved in, renovated and assumed his identity for years
articles.summary: Dennis West was found dead in his Florida home during a welfare check in July 2022.
articles.body: Dennis West was found dead in his Florida home during a welfare check in July 2022. Weeks later, one of the responding officers who discovered his body moved into the home and spent years impersonating him, according to investigators. Brian Louis Sguros, 35, an officer with the Lauderhill Police Department, was arrested Tuesday and faces several felony charges: official misconduct, criminal use of deceased person’s identification, criminal use of personal identification information, offense against a computer user, and unlawful use of a two-way communication device. It’s not clear whether Sguros has obtained an attorney. The Broward County Sheriff’s Office said in a news release that Sguros responded to the welfare check at West’s home on July 11, 2022. West, 71, was found dead inside, and his death was determined to be from natural causes, the news release stated. In paperwork Sguros allegedly filed, he admitted he took possession of the home in August 2022, weeks after West died, the release states. Sguros presented himself to the county medical examiner’s office as West’s friend, though there is no indication that Sguros knew West, according to the sheriff’s office. He also told the office that West had no living family, which is untrue, authorities said. Authorities said Sguros paid taxes and utilities on the home in West’s name. He is also accused of using West’s identification to “get the city of Lauderhill to issue a permit to facilitate repairs,” the release states. He allegedly used law enforcement databases to obtain information about West and forged West’s signature on a permit. Sguros appeared in court on Wednesday and was ordered held on a $25,000 bond, NBC South Florida reported. After his arrest, he was placed on administrative leave without pay from the Lauderhill Police Department.

articles.title: Pope does not need further treatment after lung cancer surgery
articles.summary: Test results have confirmed his diagnosis as a lung adenocarcinoma that was localised.
articles.body:
Pope Leo XIV does not need any further treatment following an operation to remove a cancerous growth from his lung, his doctors have said.

Test results on tissue removed during surgery confirmed he had had a lung adenocarcinoma, as was initially diagnosed, and that the disease was localised, according to a statement shared by the Vatican.

"A subsequent oncological assessment has confirmed that no further treatment is necessary," it added.

The 71-year-old was discharged from Rome's Gemelli Hospital over the weekend four days after his operation - stopping to speak to well-wishers as he left the grounds.

It comes as he held his first weekly general audience since leaving hospital at St Peter's Square on Wednesday.

The surgery, which took place on 13 October and lasted for 90 minutes, included the removal of the lower lobe of the Pope's right lung.

The pontiff himself had announced during his weekly Sunday prayers that he would be having the procedure - telling those gathered in St Peter's Square that doctors had found a nodule on his lung.

He said at the time that it had been caught "at an early stage".

Images shared days after his operation, on Friday, showed the Pope celebrating Mass from the hospital wearing green vestments and standing behind a makeshift altar.

On the same day, the Vatican said he spoke to Russian President Vladimir Putin over the phone to urge a ceasefire in the blockaded Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky to allow the delivery of food aid, and to call for "dialogue and peace".

The pontiff had a similar phone call with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky on Monday.

Those close to the Pope have also previously said he was keen not to delay a trip to Latin America which is planned for early November.

articles.title: Mexico ex-prosecutor charged with treason over US drug raid
articles.summary: César Jáuregui Moreno is accused of allowing US agents to join a raid on a suspected drugs lab in April.
articles.body:
Federal prosecutors in Mexico have charged a former state prosecutor with treason for allowing US agents to join a raid on a suspected drugs lab in April without proper authorisation.

César Jáuregui Moreno served as attorney general of the northern border state of Chihuahua from 2023 to this year.

The involvement of Americans came to light after two US agents said to have worked for the CIA died in a car crash in Chihuahua along with two Mexican law enforcement officers.

Attorney General Ernestina Godoy Ramos said Jáuregui had allowed foreign agents to carry out activities reserved for Mexican authorities and had failed to share information. Jáuregui has denied the allegations.

The former prosecutor, who is a member of the conservative opposition PAN party, was arrested at the weekend. A court hearing is scheduled for Saturday.

A judge must still determine whether there is enough evidence to proceed with the case, Reuters news agency reports.

Jáuregui also faces state-level charges in Chihuahua, including of abuse of public office. In a court hearing for those charges on Sunday, he denied that he instructed or consented to the involvement of US agents in the operation.

Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum has come under pressure from US President Donald Trump to crack down on drug trafficking but has repeatedly declined offers of US-led counter-narcotics operations in the country.

She has been adamant that foreign officials can only operate on Mexican soil if given prior clearance by the federal government, and has insisted the Latin American nation's sovereignty should not be breached.

The crash occurred on 19 April, when a convoy returning from an operation targeting suspected methamphetamine labs in a remote, mountainous area veered off the road and plunged into a ravine.

Two members of the Chihuahua State Investigation Agency were killed along with the Americans, officials said.

At the time, in his capacity as state attorney general, Jáuregui told a news conference that the Americans had been "instructor officers" from the US embassy engaged in "training work as part of the general and normal exchange we have with the US authorities".

US media have reported that the two individuals worked for the CIA as part of an expanded effort to combat narcotics trafficking in the region.

articles.title: Minneapolis restaurant that offered free meals to protest ICE raids announces closure
articles.summary: The Modern Times Café in Minneapolis is closing after owner Dylan Alverson's experiment with a free and donation-based restaurant model proved unsustainable.
articles.body: Modern Times Café, a Minneapolis restaurant that attempted to eliminate prices, has announced it will be closing for good by the end of the year. "For the last six years, I’ve been trying to prove that Modern Times can continue to exist," owner Dylan Alverson wrote on social media Saturday. "I’ve exhausted every option without compromising the core fundamentals that make Modern Times what it is." He added that he plans to spend the next two months celebrating the 16-year-old business and discussing ways for a business like his to continue. MINNESOTA SENATE VOTES TO BAN ICE FROM WEARING MASKS, ALLOW RESIDENTS TO SUE FOR CONSTITUTIONAL VIOLATIONS "The only way for places like Modern Times to exist in the future is to actively challenge the reasons why it can no longer exist," Alverson wrote. Alverson announced on Instagram in January that his business, which rebranded as Post Modern Times, would operate as a "free and donation-based restaurant" where everyone would be welcome "except ICE" in protest of the Immigration and Customs Enforcement operations happening in his state, partly in response to the killings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti. "We absolutely cannot go on as we have. I am sick of generating money for the soldiers in our streets and for a government that won't protect us — a government who is actively inflicting daily harm on its citizens," Alverson wrote. "Effective tomorrow we are done making money for the fascists that occupy our city." The decision was made after Pretti was shot and killed by Border Patrol agents. The Modern Times Café operated without prices for about six months until it briefly closed in July. The establishment returned to using prices once the store reopened in August but announced that it would continue serving 25 free meals per day. By October, Alverson told The New York Times he was operating under a "zero profit margin," hoping that his place could be used as a model for other restaurants. However, he acknowledged that the process was taxing for his staff and led to customers waiting up to two hours for a meal, half of which would usually be given for free. articles.title: Florida homeowners were told to pay $13,157 each for new roofs in a 160-unit complex; they now allege their HOA issued a $232,000 contractor check 12 days before the public vote, triggering a lawsuit
articles.summary: Homeowners in a 160-unit Florida townhome complex have filed a lawsuit against their homeowners association and property management company.
articles.body: Homeowners in a 160-unit Florida townhome complex have filed a lawsuit against their homeowners association and property management company. They claim a $2.1 million (£1.61 million) roofing contract was approved behind closed doors weeks before a public vote took place. The dispute involves The Vistas at Phillips Commons, a residential community in the Dr. Phillips area of Orange County, Florida. According to local reporting by WKMG ClickOrlando, residents were told that each homeowner would have to pay a special assessment of $13,157.73 (£10,120) to replace the roofs across the entire complex. Homeowners claim in court filings that financial records show association managers issued a $232,000 (£178,000) deposit check to a roofing contractor on June 10, 2026. However, the association board did not hold its official public meeting and vote on the project until June 22, 2026.Discrepancies in association recordsKenneth Yuret, a long-term resident who has lived in the community for nearly 20 years, said his roof was still in good condition and did not need to be replaced immediately. Yuret shared meeting records with WKMG ClickOrlando showing that the proposed special assessment would cost a total of $2,105,237.34. More than 100 residents attended the public board meeting on June 22 to discuss the project and vote on it. After reviewing financial records he had requested from the property managers, Yuret found that money had already been paid out 12 days before the community vote. “I found this huge discrepancy in our financials,” Yuret told WKMG ClickOrlando. “This is the smoking gun. It was shocking.”Legal violations and parallel criminal investigationThe lawsuit names both The Vistas at Phillips Commons Homeowners Association and its property management company, Beacon Community Management Inc. The homeowners claim that the board broke Florida Statute 720.303. This law requires homeowners association meetings to be open to all members. It also sets strict rules for giving public notice before voting to spend association funds or charge homeowners special assessments. Alongside the civil lawsuit, court filings reveal that the homeowners association board and Beacon Community Management Inc. are also under an active criminal investigation. The investigation concerns alleged financial irregularities and fraud. Investigators with the Orlando Police Department confirmed to WKMG ClickOrlando that a criminal investigation is underway. However, officers declined to share specific details about the investigation's scope.Management response and homeowner resistanceWhen investigative reporters from WKMG ClickOrlando contacted the homeowners association board president, the president directed all questions to the association's legal counsel. The lawyer did not respond to repeated requests for comment. Beacon Community Management Inc. also did not respond to phone calls or written emails about the lawsuit and criminal investigation. Yuret confirmed that he and other residents plan to continue their legal fight in court. They want to stop the special assessment and prevent the roofing project from moving forward. “I like HOAs, that's why I moved here,” Yuret said in comments reported by WKMG ClickOrlando. “It's a sense of security when everything is in order, but when it falls in the wrong hands, that is when we can have a problem and we do. I'm going to fight til the end. I'm not going to let a company bully me out of my own home.”You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: Sen. Susan Collins calls for removal of radio ad attacking Democrat Troy Jackson as a 'creep'
articles.summary: LEWISTON, Maine (AP) — Maine Republican Sen. Susan Collins distanced herself from a new radio ad attacking Democratic opponent Troy Jackson as a “freak” and...
articles.body:
LEWISTON, Maine (AP) — Maine Republican Sen. Susan Collins distanced herself from a new radio ad attacking Democratic opponent Troy Jackson as a "freak" and a "creep" because "he has two kids with his cousin," saying Wednesday that it should be taken down.

The spot, airing on Maine radio in the form of a country song, is from the Senate Leadership Fund, a super PAC aligned with Senate Republicans. Among the lyrics in the jingle: "If he'll screw his own family, he'll screw yours too."

Collins told reporters during a campaign appearance in Lewiston that she "had nothing to do with that ad." She added that federal law bans her from coordinating with the super PAC, but she has publicly called for it to be removed.

Previously, in a Politico story in September, Collins referenced Jackson's relationship with a second cousin.

"I'm not going to bring up the fact that the mother of his two children is his second cousin," Collins said. "I don't know whether people know that or not."

In an op-ed published Wednesday, Lana Pelletier, Jackson's partner, criticized the radio ad and other attacks on her family by Collins and her supporters, saying she never thought they "would stoop this low."

"Sen. Collins has been quick to demand respect and decency for herself. My family deserved the same," Pelletier said.

"I am not a helpless woman who needs politicians to tell the world what happened in my own life. And I am not a punchline or a caricature of where I come from," she added.

Jackson, a former state lawmaker and lumberjack, and Pelletier are longtime partners who have two sons together.

Jackson's campaign manager, Dan Gottlieb, said Wednesday that Collins owes Jackson's family an apology.

"Susan Collins herself spread these disgusting personal attacks on Troy's family," he said. "Now she wants Mainers to believe she's above the very attacks she helped spread."

Democrats are hoping for a win by Jackson over the incumbent Collins as the party tries to retake the Senate.

Also Wednesday, Collins lamented how negative much campaign advertising has been during this election cycle.

"This race is unique in Maine history in the number of personal attacks," Collins said.

Kruesi reported from Providence, Rhode Island.

Two boys aged 15 and 16 have been arrested on suspicion of attempted murder after a 16-year-old was seriously assaulted in Liverpool, police have said.

Officers were called to The Lutine Bell pub on Breck Road in Everton at about 14:15 BST following reports of a boy being assaulted nearby. He was taken to hospital with head and chest injuries where he remains in a serious condition.

A 37-year-old man and a 41-year-old woman have also been arrested on suspicion of assisting an offender. All four remain in custody, Merseyside Police said.

Det Ch Insp Paula Jones said: "We are continuing to appeal for anyone who was in the area of Breck Road shortly after 14:00 and saw, heard or captured anything to please get in touch."

articles.title: Judge orders Meta to pay $25bn in fines for Facebook privacy violations
articles.summary: A jury found Meta guilty of lying to Facebook users in ⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠New Mexico about access to their data.
articles.body:
A United States judge has ordered Meta to pay $25bn after a jury found the company misled Facebook users about privacy violations, marking the biggest fine ever against the tech giant.

New Mexico state District Judge Francis Mathew issued the ruling on Wednesday.

“Facebook promised users that they (the users) controlled their data. This was false,” he said.

Last month, a jury found Meta responsible for more than 43 million violations of New Mexico’s consumer protection laws. New Mexico Attorney General Raul Torrez highlighted that the decision was one of the largest state verdicts against a company in US history.

“This judgement should be a signal, an unambiguous message, to Silicon Valley,” Torrez said at a news conference.

Meta lawyer Matt Nicholson argued in court that a sum as high as $40bn would be “shocking to the conscience”, while a lawyer for New Mexico, Randi McGinn, urged standing up to “tech titans who think they are bulletproof and can do whatever they want”.

“The jury didn’t make findings that any New Mexican heard or saw these statements, or was harmed by them,” Nicholson argued during a hearing held early this month.

Torrez told reporters following the verdict that all the money awarded would go into a fund for the state’s education system.

The amount awarded in the case far exceeds the $5bn fine that the Federal Trade Commission levied against Facebook in 2019.

New Mexico accused Meta of misleading users about who could access their personal information and how harmful content was handled on its platforms. Jurors found that 26 of 29 statements made by Meta and its leadership on privacy and content moderation were misleading.

Meta plans to appeal the verdict, potentially reducing the final payment amount.

In a statement, CJ Mahoney, Meta’s chief legal officer, said the company is confident it will win on appeal.

“This ruling, and the Attorney General’s approach to this enforcement, makes it all but impossible to do business in the state of New Mexico,” Mahoney said. “At its core, this lawsuit seeks to impose a tax on speech to enforce new rules for what people can say online.”

The lawsuit, filed in 2021, stemmed partly from revelations that Cambridge Analytica , a British political consulting firm that is now defunct, had obtained personal data from as many as 87 million Facebook users without their consent and used it to develop targeted political advertisements. Its clients included President Donald Trump’s 2016 presidential campaign.

The case, a major setback for the tech giant, marks the second legal defeat for Meta in New Mexico in six months. In March, a jury found the company misled users about the safety of young people on Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, ordering it to pay $375m in civil penalties . Meta was later ordered to make an additional $567m payment into a state fund for teen mental health and was required to implement measures to protect young users.

articles.title: SC stays probe against Vijayan & kin for a week to enable him to move high court
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Supreme Court Wednesday stayed for a week Kerala Police’s investigation against ex-CM Pinarayi Vijayan and his relatives in the CMRL-Exalogic
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Supreme Court Wednesday stayed for a week Kerala Police’s investigation against ex-CM Pinarayi Vijayan and his relatives in the CMRL-Exalogic payoff case and said a division bench of HC should not have refused them permission to appeal against the single judge’s order directing an FIR and probe.A special bench of Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana, hearing appeals filed by Vijayan, his daughter Veena T and son-in-law Mohd Riyas PA, stayed the probe by state police.Referring to Section 175(4) of BNSS, which requires a report from the public servant’s superior officer before ordering an investigation into a complaint against the public servant for acts done in discharge of official duties, the bench said, “The single judge not only directed registration of FIR, which is the mandate in SC ruling in Vijay Madanlal case, but ordered commencement of investigation and submission of final report.”“Commencement of investigation and taking the same to logical conclusion will require due compliance with other statutory requirements under the special law (as laid down in Charanjit Singh judgement of Supreme Court),” it said.“These facts clearly make out a prima facie case of locus standi for the petitioners to seek leave to appeal against (single judge’s) order. Accordingly, we set aside the impugned order and permit the petitioners to pursue their appeals before the division bench of the HC,” it added.SC clarified that its observations did not touch upon the merits of the case. “The investigation into FIR shall remain stayed for seven days,” it said.On an ECIR registered by ED on the basis of the FIR lodged by Kerala Police, the bench said it was not expressing any opinion on its validity.When Kerala govt undertook not to proceed with the probe till division bench decided the appeals, SC said, “Your client was so eager to investigate. We do not appreciate the state govt functioning like this.”On Sept 7, two years after registering an ECIR, ED shared information with state police regarding the alleged payoff case. State govt set up an SIT for a preliminary inquiry. On Oct 9, a single judge set aside the inquiry and directed filing of an FIR, lodged on Oct 12.Vijayan told SC the alleged payments were made between 2017 and 2020 by CMRL to Exalogic, in which he was never a shareholder, director or employee.
